content:
mike: Quick check before the change window closes — deploy-bot shows a push scheduled for 02:00 UTC to prod-northeast for `rwd-model:v3.1`.
mike: This is a last-minute pin of the hotfix branch into the release stream. Need explicit: pin approval, canary plan, and rollback criteria. cc @alex @lina @priya

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy created by mike at 02:00 UTC -> rwd-model:v3.1 -> prod-northeast. Canary: 10% traffic, 10 minutes. Change window: 02:00-04:00 UTC. Tags: freeze-exempt:manual-approval

alex: Ack. I can sign the pin if we keep canary at 10% and hold for 10m with smoke checks.

lina: Quick note — this hotfix touches tokenizer shard loading; keep extra eye on mem OOM and startup latency. If warm-up spikes >50% then rollback.

priya: Proposing explicit rollback triggers:
- error-rate increase >3% for 5m (all 5xx combined)
- request p95 latency >600ms for 5m
- OOM or crashloop on any node
- model mismatch in tracing (>1% requests returning schema errors)
If any of these happen during canary -> immediate pin rollback.

oncall-sre: Monitoring runbooks linked. Pager thresholds will be enabled for this run. I'll watch the first canary wave. Will page if latency or error thresholds cross.

mike: Agree with priya triggers. Add fallback plan: if canary fails, deploy-bot should auto-pin back to `rwd-model:v3.0` and trigger incident channel.

alex: Add a soft-fail condition: if token generation quality regressions (per quick eval) exceed 4% of sampled prompts -> pause rollout and escalate to ML.

lina: For smoke checklist (to be run during canary):
```bash
# from staging utility
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN" -d '{"input":"short prompt"}' https://api.redwood/prod-northeast/generate | jq .
# expect 200 and tokens ~20-60, no schema errors
``` 

mike: Who will run the smoke? @lina you volunteer? :eyes:

lina: I'll run the 0m and 5m smoke and post outputs here. If all green, thumbs from alex and priya we proceed to full rollout.

deploy-bot: NOTE: Pin command available: `deploy-bot pin rwd-model:v3.1 --env prod-northeast --reason \"hotfix pin\"`.

priya: Docs: rollback checklist in the release playbook under /docs/releases/rollback.md — follow step-by-step. Also ensure Canary TTL is 10m; do not extend without sign-off.

alex: +1 on strict TTL. If canary passes, we'll increment to 50% for 15m, then to 100% with staggered nodes.

oncall-sre: I'll keep dashboards open and annotate timeline. If anything noisy, I'll trigger rollback and post the incident stub here.

mike: Final ask: everyone add :thumbsup: in thread if you approve the pin + triggers. If no objections in 15m, I will approve and kick off the deploy.

lina: :thumbsup:
priya: :thumbsup:
alex: :thumbsup:
oncall-sre: :thumbsup:

mike: Approved, proceeding to pin and schedule.

deploy-bot: action: pinned rwd-model:v3.1 to prod-northeast by mike at 02:00 UTC. Canary initialized at 02:00 UTC.

lina: 02:05 smoke: all checks pass, no schema errors, memory stable.

oncall-sre: Watching metrics — p95 at 320ms, errors 0.4%.

priya: Good to move to 50% after 10m if stable. Remember rollback triggers for auto pin-back.

mike: Thanks team — keeping channel for realtime notes. If anyone sees anomalies, post here and we'll follow rollback playbook. :rocket:
